facts.statement: Job NBL-008-3466 is check-out works at Flat 5, 55 Lantern Quay, Cedarford, ZZ2 4ZZ: repaint, replace burnt bedroom carpet, replace bathroom flooring, repair broken plug, dripping bath tap and damaged bathroom shelf.
The property is not tenanted; the system paused the request for that reason on 6 April 2025.
First estimate £1,370.00 with no VAT itemised; its scope excludes the bedroom carpet ('carpet in the main room can stay as it's not that bad') and includes replacing the bathroom tap.
The landlord asked for a second quote for comparison (6 April 2025); the second quote was £1,700.00 + VAT.
Both quotes with their VAT position were put to the landlord on 25 May 2025 naming 'Flat 5', and the landlord approved the cheaper provider the same day.
The provider confirmed willingness to proceed on 26 May 2025; works were reported complete on 2 June 2025.

Final invoice is £1,190.00 with no VAT stated, for painting the bathroom in damp paint, painting all walls and ceiling in the main room, replacing bathroom lino, repairing the plug socket and repairing the shelf; no photos included.
The bath tap was not replaced because the provider found it did not need replacing, which is why the invoice is below the approved estimate.
The burnt bedroom carpet was not replaced: it was excluded from the estimate the landlord approved, and it does not appear on the invoice.
The invoice was forwarded to the landlord on 2 June 2025 and the landlord authorised payment on 17 June 2025 ('Ok to pay'), after the system had already closed the request on 2 June 2025.
Photo upload was skipped with the recorded reason 'No photos attached'.
Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors are recorded as tested — Yes, with no adverse comments, in both check-out reports.

Both check-out reports record a bedroom ceiling watermark and evidence of water ingress to the ceiling; this item was never quoted and is absent from the invoiced scope. Bathroom water damage to boxing was covered by the damp-paint works.
The estimate and invoice are headed 'Alder Compliance' while the history calls the approved provider 'Eliza Bennett'; the quoted figure £1,370.00 matches exactly across both.
Several outbound agency emails on this job name other properties in the body while the header, reports and financial documents are Flat 5, 55 Lantern Quay.

Re: check-out works, Flat 5, 55 Lantern Quay, Cedarford, ZZ2 4ZZ (job NBL-008-3466).

Thank you for your authorisation to pay. For your record, the final position on this job:

- Works completed and reported on 2 June 2025; the provider you approved on 25 May 2025 carried them out.
- Final invoice £1,190.00 (no VAT stated), against the approved estimate of £1,370.00 — the bath tap did not need replacing, so the cost came in lower. The invoice was sent to you on 2 June 2025 and your authorisation has been passed to our accounts team for processing; we do not release payment ourselves.
- Works invoiced: bathroom sanded, filled and painted in damp paint; all walls and ceiling painted in the main room; bathroom lino replaced; plug socket repaired; shelf repaired.
- No completion photographs were supplied by the provider, so the photo upload was recorded as skipped.

Two items from the original instruction are still outstanding and are not covered by this invoice:

1. Burnt bedroom carpet. The approved estimate excluded it ("carpet in the main room can stay as it's not that bad"), so it has not been replaced. The check-out report records burn damage plus multiple stains needing professional cleaning.
2. Bedroom ceiling water ingress. Both check-out reports record watermarking and evidence of water ingress to the bedroom ceiling. This was never quoted or repaired, and the source has not been investigated. We would recommend having the cause identified before the room is re-let, as leaks tend to recur.

If you would like either item quoted, please reply and we will raise it as a new request. Any question of a deposit deduction for the carpet or other end-of-tenancy damage will be dealt with separately by the property manager, not on this job.

This request is now closed.
